speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off with the reef, because there is some cautiously good news out there. Long term monitoring teams have been tracking coral cover in the northern sections and things are looking more resilient than a lot of people feared a few years back.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah it's not all doom and gloom mate, which makes a nice change. Scientists reckon a run of milder summers combined with reef protection work has given the coral a bit of breathing room to bounce back in places.

speaker: alice
text: It's a timely reminder too, with Queensland pushing hard on big battery storage and pumped hydro projects to get more renewables onto the grid. Every bit of clean energy we add takes a bit of pressure off that reef down the track.
